claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Micron 之後的財報、10-K 或新聞稿寫出 9650 停產、退出 BlueField-4 STX 參考架構，或 NVIDIA 參考架構文件列出的 SSD 不含 Micron。核查頻率：每季（Micron 財報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀本層供給側。
claims.statement: Micron (GTC 2026-03-16): the 9650 data center SSD, the first PCIe Gen6 SSD in high-volume production per Micron, is optimized for agentic AI training and inference workloads on the NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX reference architecture (28 GB/s sequential read, 5.5M random read IOPS). Supplier self-report of design-in to a reference architecture; no customer orders or volumes are stated.

sources.quote: Industry's first PCIe® Gen6 SSD in high-volume production3 — the Micron 9650 data center SSD delivers up to two times the read performance of Gen5 at 100% higher performance per watt4 and optimized for agentic AI workloads on NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX architecture

The Micron 9650 is optimized for energy efficiency and liquid-cooled environments, delivering high-speed, low-latency data access for AI training and inference workloads with the NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX reference architecture, supporting up to 28 GB/s sequential read throughput and 5.5 million random read IOPS.
